_comment: MFL-0008 data-class fitness over the LIVE kernel-crate corpus. Until governance/check/data-class/tests/data_class_coverage.rs landed, this doctrine had never produced a verdict about this codebase: the kernel's only consumer was marketplace/facade/dev-cli, which no workflow invokes, so every case it had ever run was one of the four hand-written fixtures inside src/lib.rs — and the allowance ledger it validates against had silently stopped matching a single live field. `frozen_unannotated_fields` maps every unannotated kernel field to whether registry/data-class/legacy-unannotated-fields.tsv allows it, pinned by EQUALITY over the UNION of the frozen and observed key sets and therefore TWO-SIDED: a new unannotated field blocks (this doctrine is fail-closed for new fields), an annotated one blocks until struck so the win is recorded, and BOTH directions of ledger edit flip a value and block. Keys are `<path>::<Struct>::<field>` — never line-anchored, so an edit above a field does not force a blind re-freeze. The min_* floors are the anti-vacuity oracle; all but one count SUBJECTS, and the one that does not (min_annotated_fields) counts the COMPLIANT half and so only ever rises as the debt is paid. No floor here can red on honest progress.
subject: `pub struct` fields in the tracked src/**.rs of every workspace member whose registry/catalog/<package>.yaml declares `role: kernel` — the same scan set marketplace/facade/dev-cli/src/data_class_gates.rs selects, replayed rather than reinvented
_measured_2026_08_19: Measured on dev @ bc6e04fa1: 150 kernel-tier workspace members, 221 tracked kernel sources over 13761 tracked paths, 2762 pub struct fields, 2029 annotated, 733 unannotated — 274 of them allowed by the 274-row ledger and 459 unallowed. Zero stale ledger rows and zero unscanned kernel catalogs, but only after this same change rewrote every ledger path `crates/...` -> `libs/...`: the 13 shared kernels the ledger covers had MOVED, so under the kernel's own rule all 274 rows were StaleLegacyAllowance and all 733 unannotated fields were unallowed. All 274 rows match an existing unannotated field after the rewrite and none is stale, which is the evidence that a move, not a deletion, is what happened.
_frozen_stale_allowances_comment: A ledger row matching no unannotated field. Pinned by EQUALITY at the empty set, never by a floor — the honest target of this term is ZERO, and a floor on a zero-target term goes red exactly when the doctrine succeeds, which is the shape of guard that gets deleted for crying wolf.
_frozen_unscanned_kernel_catalogs_commen: A `role: kernel` catalog resolving to a workspace member the scan never covered — a kernel crate escaping the doctrine while every other count still looks healthy. Empty today, pinned by equality for the same reason as the term above.
